verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain JavaScript functions that use JSX, so markup and rendering logic live together in one component. Developers 'don't have to learn a new rendering system', and a `<div>` is a real DOM div. Community reports from React developers describe the switch as painless and familiar. missing for 10: any evidence on styling or CSS within components, in-depth first-party documentation of the JSX templating model, and independent corroboration that it needs no new knowledge (some users find prop and reactivity rules unintuitive).
